stocks.name: Meteoric Resources
stocks.narrative: Lynas Rare Earths agreed on 1 Oct 2026 to acquire Meteoric by scheme at 0.0207 Lynas shares per MEI share (implied A$0.286, a 68.4% premium to the A$0.170 last close; ~A$968m fully diluted). The board unanimously recommends it absent a superior proposal and subject to the independent expert. A A$8.8m break fee applies in some cases. MEI now trades as a merger-arb on Lynas's share price, and the key risks are deal approvals and Brazilian clearances.
